name: aviOS
summary: An AI layer for aircraft maintenance that answers plain-language questions from your manuals, records and work history, cites every source, and says so when the answer is not there. Modules cover each tail, work orders and deferrals, a records vault for logbooks and 8130s, parts, and shift notes and handoffs. It sits on top of the systems you already run, and a certified technician always makes the call.

whyItMatters: Every hour a tech spends hunting through manuals and old write-ups is billable time lost or an aircraft still down. Capturing shift notes and the know-how of your senior techs also protects you when they retire. Test it on one chronic squawk where the evidence was hard to assemble.
